name: Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. (QIE) is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of advanced precision assembly technologies for electronics. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, featuring a diverse array of precision soldering equipment, which includes iron, laser, selective, hotbar, high-frequency induction, and hot air soldering systems, as well as specialized micro spot welding and molten-type soldering robots. Beyond soldering, QIE provides essential automation systems such as double-sided, top, and bottom automatic optical inspection (AOI), dispensing systems, and automated screwing systems. Their product range further extends to specialized BGA rework stations, intelligent soldering/desoldering/rework solutions, ESD protection, and fume extraction systems. Additionally, QIE develops complete production line solutions tailored for applications like PCBA-DIP, 5G filter, 3G electronic, EPB, ignition coil, and chip module integrations. These sophisticated solutions are vital across various industrial sectors, including 3C intelligent terminals and modules, automotive electronics, 5G telecommunications infrastructure, smart home devices, and the burgeoning new energy lithium battery industry. Founded in 1993, Quick Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
